summary: auth set-token and auth logout write and remove the credentials file colocated with an explicit --config when it exists, the same file Load reads first; auth set-token also accepts the legacy positional token with a stdin warning.
reason: The generated save path always used the global credentials file, so with an explicit --config that had its own data/credentials.toml the command reported success while the old token stayed active. Earlier releases took the token positionally; rejecting it would break existing scripts.
validated_outcome: TestSetTokenWritesExplicitConfigCredentials and TestSetTokenAcceptsLegacyPositionalToken fail on the generated code and pass here.
